rubric: The rewritten text comes first and in full; the same language and format as the original.
Every fact, number, name and condition of the original is kept or named as cut; nothing new is added.
The target is met with numbers: shorter means about half, much shorter a third; simpler means short sentences and everyday words; formal means no slang or contractions.
Exactly one 'Changed:' line after the text, no explanations of writing rules.
One version unless options were asked for.

prompts.text: Make this shorter: 'I just wanted to reach out and let you know that I have been thinking about the proposal that you sent over last week and I have some thoughts and ideas that I would like to share with you at some point when you have a free moment in your schedule.'
Mach das freundlicher, es ist für einen Kunden: 'Ihre Bestellung kann nicht geliefert werden, weil Sie eine falsche Adresse angegeben haben. Schicken Sie uns die richtige.'
بسّط هذا النص لطفل عمره عشر سنوات: 'يحدث الكسوف الشمسي عندما يمر القمر بين الأرض والشمس فيحجب ضوءها جزئيًا أو كليًا عن منطقة معينة من سطح الأرض.'
Turn these notes into one paragraph for a report: meeting 3 May; budget approved 12k; launch date moved to October; Sara leads testing; need 2 more testers by June.
Formuliere das formeller für eine Bewerbung: 'Ich bin echt gut mit Leuten und hab in meinem letzten Job viel mit Kunden gemacht, die waren immer zufrieden.'
Less angry please, but keep the point: 'This is the third time your delivery is late. I am done waiting. Send my money back now or I will leave a review everyone will see.'
